baseline.name: Original-to-clone hash map
baseline.approach: Allocate clones and use a map to translate original next/random pointers.
baseline.space: O(n) auxiliary map plus O(n) output nodes

archived.name: Weave, connect random pointers, unweave
archived.space: O(1) auxiliary pointers plus O(n) output nodes

why: The clone next to each original temporarily acts as the translation map, so random targets resolve without a separate table.
quantitative_comparison: The archive replaces n map entries with a constant number of working pointers while still allocating n clones. Both have linear expected traversal work; the archive uses three explicit passes.
tradeoffs: Temporarily mutates the original list, excludes concurrent readers, and has no allocation-failure rollback. The map baseline can leave the original structure untouched.
evidence_basis: Static ownership/storage comparison against the stated map baseline; no matched timing.
